hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'catalog.json'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "catalog.json is product data. Do not modify without explicit instruction from Ciamac. Data changes go through Jeremy after Luiz approval."}'; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'vite.config'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "vite.config.js is frozen. Do not modify."}'; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'src/'; then echo '{"additionalContext": "Source file was modified. Run constraint validation suite (npm test) before committing."}'; fi
if [ -f SESSION_STATE.md ]; then echo '{"additionalContext": "SESSION_STATE.md exists. Read it for tactical handoff."}'; fi
